mechanism.claim: An extreme completed four-hour DOGE quote-turnover burst accompanied by an extreme DOGE return during elevated BTC variation marks saturation of meme-led speculative attention. Fade the completed DOGE direction on BTC for eight elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: negative strict sign of completed DOGE four-hour log return
mechanism.why_distinct: Existing cross-alt candidates use breadth, majority, residual, funding, or aggregate flow across six alts. This candidate uses DOGE-specific meme-attention saturation jointly identified by its own quote turnover and price displacement.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: published four-hour connectedness evidence reports that positive net memecoin spillovers can precede crashes in leading cryptocurrencies; the candidate requires elevated causal BTC variation
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: a DOGE-specific four-hour saturation clock is absent from Gross9

features.source: read-only Postgres bars_binance DOGEUSDT and BTCUSDT exact 1m bars
features.availability: decision at exact UTC four-hour boundary after all 240 source minutes are complete
features.block: [decision-4h, decision), exact 240 one-minute rows for both symbols
features.doge_return: log(last DOGE close / first DOGE open), strict nonzero
features.doge_abs_return_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid four-hour blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.doge_quote_turnover: sum DOGE quote_asset_volume over completed block, finite positive
features.doge_turnover_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.85
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact BTC one-minute close-to-close log returns within completed block, including first close versus prior minute close)
features.btc_variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.reservation: nonoverlapping; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

definitions.no_doge_return_tail: turnover and BTC variation gates without DOGE return rank
definitions.no_doge_turnover_tail: return and BTC variation gates without DOGE turnover rank
definitions.no_btc_variation_gate: DOGE return and turnover tails only
definitions.one_block_stale_doge: prior DOGE return/turnover state with current BTC variation

source_plan.database: read-only bars_binance exact columns, query text frozen before incidence
source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.paper: Will memecoins' surge trigger a crypto crash? Evidence from the connectedness between leading cryptocurrencies and memecoins
research_boundary.selection_basis: independent DOGE-specific meme attention saturation mechanism

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no source, symbol, block, rank, variation, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
